notes: Daily OHLCV market data for ADA quoted in USD.
Rows with close_usd <= 0 are excluded from normalized outputs; CCData's allData response includes zero-filled pre-market rows before ADA traded.
Use close_usd on the selected policy date for reproducible USD-to-ADA estimates.
This dataset estimates historical ADA equivalents; it does not prove actual disbursement transaction amounts.
CoinGecko public API full-range access was unavailable during implementation because public requests were limited to the trailing 365 days.
